message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: Defendant Cha (查某某) contracted a fire restaurant renovation for 240,000 yuan. From Nov to Dec 2015, he hired workers (including Liu, Zhong, etc.) to do renovation. After completion, he received 220,000 yuan of project payment and left. He paid some labor wages but still owed about 57,000 yuan to ten workers. The labor bureau ordered payment. Cha escaped, refused to pay. After police case, Cha paid the owed wages. He admitted. Evidence.

Thus the crime is refusing to pay labor remuneration. The list includes "拒不支付劳动报酬". Indeed there is a label exactly: "拒不支付劳动报酬". So the charge is that.

Any other charges? Possibly "合同诈骗"? He contracted and then didn't pay wages. But the facts show he did receive payment and left, but he owed wages. The crime is refusing to pay labor remuneration, which is a specific offense. The list includes that label. So answer: [罪名]拒不支付劳动报酬<eoa>
